title: Lifting a finite machine to a larger alphabet
statement: Let $M$ be a bundled finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols, and let $e$ inject the Boolean alphabet into $\Gamma$, where equality in $\Gamma$ is decidable. The resulting finite machine over $\Gamma$ has the same number of work tapes and the same finite state set, and uses the transition behavior obtained by decoding symbols in the image of $e$, treating other symbols as blank, and mapping written and output symbols through $e$.
hypotheses_covered: A bundled finite Turing machine over Bool
